title: Arcs & trimmedPath: Progress Ring
hints: A ring is a circle path, trimmed to a fraction of its length.

jsBridge: A progress ring is a circle trimmed to a fraction with `trimmedPath(from:to:)`, or `.trim` on a `Shape`. SVG's `stroke-dasharray` trick does the same in the browser.
